name: Quantum Sensing and Measurement
description: Introduction to quantum sensing and metrology; fundamentals of quantum sensor architecture, Bloch sphere representation of quantum states; quantum state measurement; decoherence; applications in engineering, fundamental physics, biology, medicine, aerospace, geoscience; superposition and entanglement, super-resolution and super-sensitivity, detection of quantum states by measuring temporal photon statistics and spatial photon distribution; SPAD, SNSPD, EMCCD, laser cooling; atomic clock, quantum radar, magnetometers, inertial sensors, quantum imaging and metrology, quantum noise, shot noise, squeezed states, LIGO, quantum gravimeter, quantum accelerometer, quantum gyroscope; quantum distributed sensor network.
